title: What's new: explore the latest features on PanKbase
bodyHtml:
At the American Diabetes Association (ADA) meeting, PanKbase will release new site enhancements, analysis features, and more.

New site features include:

  • An updated dataset within the Integrated Cell Browser
  • A Differential Gene Expression Browser with analyses of differential expression of pseudobulk RNA-seq data
  • An enhanced PanKgraph interface enabling users to explore more biological questions through a knowledge graph interface
  • A community forum
  • A GitHub repository enabling users to submit feature requests and bug reports

Stay tuned for more developments in the coming months!
summary: At the 2025 American Diabetes Association meeting, PanKbase will release new site enhancements, analysis features, and more. Read the article to learn more.
